note: ML Runtime provides cluster compute with preinstalled GPU drivers and popular ML frameworks like PyTorch for distributed training.
AI Runtime is managed serverless GPU compute with per-minute billing and automatic scaling for notebook and CLI access.
Ray Train orchestrates distributed training across GPUs and compute nodes for PyTorch and TensorFlow frameworks.
Ray Tune runs distributed hyperparameter search trials with early stopping and MLflow integration for experiment tracking.
TorchDistributor launches distributed PyTorch training on Spark cluster resources with minimal code changes from standard PyTorch.
Spark MLlib provides distributed ML algorithms like classification, regression, and clustering via the pyspark.ml API.
DeepSpeed enables memory-efficient scaling of large model training through parameter sharding and CPU offload techniques.
ZeRO stages partition optimizer state, gradients, and model parameters across workers for memory efficiency at scale.
Gradient partitioning distributes gradients across workers so each worker computes only its subset for memory efficiency.
The @distributed decorator enables multi-GPU training on serverless AI Runtime without requiring Spark.
Databricks offers Python, R, SQL and Scala with preinstalled ML frameworks for data science.
Languages and frameworks for data science include Python, R, Spark and Ray.
The Python Ecosystem provides preinstalled ML libraries including pandas, scikit-learn, and XGBoost.
The pandas library provides data manipulation and analysis on ML Runtimes for analytics and feature engineering.
The scikit-learn library provides algorithms for classification, regression, and clustering on ML Runtimes.
XGBoost is a gradient boosting library preinstalled on ML Runtimes for high-performance tabular data classification and regression.
LightGBM is a fast gradient boosting library preinstalled on ML Runtimes as a memory-efficient alternative to XGBoost.
The statsmodels library provides statistical modeling and hypothesis testing for classical statistical analysis.
R Support enables R code in notebooks via the %r magic command on dedicated compute, not serverless.
PySpark is the Python API for Apache Spark and enables distributed DataFrame operations for massive-scale data processing.
Spark MLlib provides distributed ML algorithms via pyspark.ml for classification, regression, and clustering on Spark.
Ray is a framework-agnostic distributed computing system for hyperparameter tuning, training, and data processing.
Deep Learning Frameworks include PyTorch with top-tier support and TensorFlow with legacy support on specific Runtimes.
PyTorch is a GPU-native deep learning framework with preinstalled CPU and GPU builds on Databricks ML Runtimes.
TensorFlow is a legacy framework available only on Runtime 17.3 LTS and scheduled for removal in future Databricks versions.
The pandas API on Spark scales pandas-compatible code from single-node to distributed DataFrames for data engineering.
Spark NLP is a community-integrated NLP library for tokenization, named entity recognition, and embeddings on Spark.
